paper.title_en: Teukolsky equations in perturbations of Kerr
paper.abstract_en: The Kerr stability conjecture has been proved in the slowly rotating case, i.e., $|a|\ll m$, in the sequence of works \cite{KS-GCM1} \cite{KS-GCM2} \cite{KS:Kerr} by Sergiu Klainerman and the author, \cite{GKS22} by Elena Giorgi, Sergiu Klainerman and the author, and \cite{Shen} by Dawei Shen, and extended in \cite{Sze}, by the author, to the full subextremal range $|a|<m$, thereby completing the proof of the Kerr stability conjecture. The proof in \cite{Sze} crucially relies on the two companion papers \cite{MaSz24} \cite{MaSz26} by Siyuan Ma and the author, in which we prove energy-Morawetz estimates respectively for the scalar wave equation and for Teukolsky equations on perturbations of Kerr with $|a|<m$. In addition, two results in \cite{Sze}, concerning the derivation of the Teukolsky wave-transport system in perturbations of Kerr and energy-Morawetz estimates for Teukolsky in the setting of \cite{Sze}, are stated without proofs. The goal of the present paper companion paper to \cite{Sze} is to provide the proof of these two results.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文是Kerr稳定性证明序列中的companion paper，为扰动Kerr时空中Teukolsky波-输运系统的推导以及能量-Morawetz估计两个此前未加证明的结果提供证明，理论深度高，方法学意义明确，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞微扰理论的核心方向。
decision.abstract_zh: Kerr稳定性猜想已在慢旋转情形，即$|a|\ll m$，由Sergiu Klainerman与本文作者的一系列工作\cite{KS-GCM1} \cite{KS-GCM2} \cite{KS:Kerr}、Elena Giorgi、Sergiu Klainerman与本文作者的工作\cite{GKS22}，以及Dawei Shen的工作\cite{Shen}所证明，并由本文作者在\cite{Sze}中推广至整个次极值范围$|a|<m$，从而完成了Kerr稳定性猜想的证明。\cite{Sze}中的证明关键依赖于Siyuan Ma与本文作者的两篇姊妹论文\cite{MaSz24} \cite{MaSz26}，在其中我们分别证明了Kerr扰动（$|a|<m$）上标量波动方程的能量-Morawetz估计以及Teukolsky方程的能量-Morawetz估计。此外，\cite{Sze}中的两个结果，分别关于在Kerr扰动中推导Teukolsky波-输运系统，以及在\cite{Sze}的设定下对Teukolsky的能量-Morawetz估计，是未加证明地陈述的。本文作为\cite{Sze}的姊妹论文，目标是为这两个结果提供证明。
